`rebar.opcert_service.config.OpcertServiceConfig` exposes `shutdown_cancel_seconds`, sourced from `REBAR_OPCERT_SHUTDOWN_CANCEL_SECONDS`, falling back to the default when missing, unparseable, or non-positive.
The op-cert worker runs jobs on an app-owned executor, NOT the event loop's default executor, and `lifespan` shutdown bounds the task join and abandons the executor without waiting.

A regression test in `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py` enqueues a deliberately blocking job and asserts lifespan shutdown returns in well under that job's duration. It FAILS against the pre-fix code and PASSES after.
